progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ab4 and dwells most on A in Mansoori, Pt. 1. The line peaks at A4 (439.6 Hz) at 0:34.8. It closes on Fs4, not the tonic (Fs4 → Ek4 → Fs4 → E4 → Fs4 → Fs4).
